reference.creator: Rowland Network Communications
reference.conditioning_text: That's no small feat and it's something I'm extremely proud of.
reference.transcription: Existing faster-whisper-small via VoiceStudio; clip and wider context agree on the complete sentence. Not human-listened.
reference.selection_reason: One complete sentence with bounded ASR start/end, no neighbouring sentence. Engine max reference is 20 seconds; this was a phrase selection, not a hard engine limit.
reference.isolation: The original is a continuous first-person CD message about his own Coast to Coast AM programme. No human music/overlap assessment has been performed.
reference.rights_status: Public accessibility of the preserved primary-source artifact does not constitute a licence grant or endorsement.
reference.reuse_note: Samme tidligere valgte referanse og lokal profil som radioverten; ingen ny innhenting eller referanseendring i denne leveransen.

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

postprocessing: Per-clip constant gain toward -20 dBFS non-silent RMS (-50 dBFS block threshold), capped at -2 dBFS decoded-MP3 peak. Mono 24 kHz, 64 kbit/s MP3; no dynamic compression, pitch shift or time stretch in the asset conversion.
library_reference: prosjektbibliotek/OFFENTLIG_INVENTAR.md entry for debpalash/VoiceStudio. Existing VoiceStudio 0.5.6 and already installed OmniVoice/faster-whisper-small reused. No new model or service installed.
voice_label: Art Bell synthetic parody for Earl in town
scope: Kun statisk EA-tale under PEOPLE.host: første møte, gjenbesøk og alle fire samtaleemner. Spillersvar, asider, knapper og vitnepapirer er utelatt.
generator: tools/artbell-town/generate.py; separat bank basert på den kontrollerte Art Bell-generatoren.
voice_profile_origin: Eksisterende lokal profil 494881fc gjenbrukes uten endring. Ingen ny referanse, profil, modell eller samtykkebekreftelse.
normalization: Whitespace collapse and trim; ID = SHA-256(normalized UTF-8 text).slice(0,16).
runtime_assets: 16 genererte MP3-filer og catalog.json. Ingen kildelyd, referanse-WAV, modell, lokal tjeneste eller private filstier.

qa.asr_interpretation: Alle 16 har gjenkjennelig, sammenhengende tale. De to strenge avvikene er sammenskrivingen Every one/Everyone, homofonen reel/Real, Twelve/12 og apostrofen i Record's/Records. Ingen omgenerering er begrunnet av disse alene. Dette er automatisk ordkontroll, ikke menneskelig lytting.
